# Quietly

Quietly is an open-source Maven plugin for Quarkus and Hibernate projects. It discovers compiled JPA entities and
Hibernate filters, diagnoses filter-test readiness, and incrementally generates JUnit/RestAssured integration tests.

Website: https://quietly.cloud

## Documentation

The canonical documentation is published under quietly.cloud from source files maintained in the Quietly repository:

## Maven

Current version: `0.2.0`

- `io.github.quietly-official:quietly-parent:0.2.0`
- `io.github.quietly-official:quietly-core:0.2.0`
- `io.github.quietly-official:quietly-test-support:0.2.0`
- `io.github.quietly-official:quietly-maven-plugin:0.2.0`

## Goals

- `quietly:scan` — inventory discovered Hibernate filters.
- `quietly:doctor` — diagnose service, field, fixture, module, and generated-test state.
- `quietly:filter-tests` — incrementally generate filter integration tests.
- `quietly:crud-tests` — generate experimental convention-based CRUD smoke tests.

## Source

https://github.com/quietly-official/quietly

## Releases

https://central.sonatype.com/artifact/io.github.quietly-official/quietly-maven-plugin/0.2.0

## Important limitations

- Quietly operates on the current `MavenProject`; it does not automatically traverse a Maven reactor.
- Entity discovery indexes the current module's compiled output, not arbitrary dependency JARs.
- CRUD generation is experimental and limited to fixed GET smoke-test conventions.
- SQL fixtures, business data, database/security configuration, and runtime environment remain consumer responsibilities.
- Generation readiness is not runtime test coverage; Quietly reports execution as `NOT_MEASURED`.
